zillow.note: Team-wide rating across all Palisade Realty agents on Zillow, not Hedda Parashos individually.

reviews.reviewText: Hedda and her team were incredible from start to finish -- her online portal helped me keep track of homes that were coming on the market; when I found homes I liked her team quickly setup up tours; I felt completely supported and advocated for during the process of making an offer and negotiating with the sellers; and during the escrow/closing (and beyond) Hedda and her team provided quick replies and accurate/helpful information the whole way through. On top of all that, Hedda is incredibly friendly and warm, and added personal touches to her service that made me realize how much she cared about supporting me and my interests throughout the entire process. I wouldn't use anyone else!

Hedda is the best realtor I have ever had! She is truly a client's advocate and goes above and beyond to ensure that every question and concern is addressed promptly and thoroughly. She is very enthusiastic but never pushy. She genuinely cares about her clients. I trust her completely. In fact, I have hired her to sell one property and help me purchase two properties. I have told her that she is my realtor for life because her customer service is outstanding. I highly recommend her if you are looking for a sharp, kind, prepared, patient, and caring realtor.

Hedda provided a world class experience and helped me and my husband through our first home buying experience in a very challenging/competitive market. Her local knowledge and experience was 100% evident in the way she guided us to our dream home. It was EXTREMELY helpful having such an experienced mind on our side to navigate the multi-offer scenario and she was able to help get our offer excepted on the house we wanted most! Extremely responsive throughout the entire process and her negotiating skills were TOP NOTCH. We would recommend Hedda and her business to anyone who wants a brilliant real estate mind on their side.

I just wanted to send you a quick message in praise of Hedda and her team. The whole team is something I have never seen in process that went so smooth and fast. They sold my condo basically in two weeks in a changing market for top dollar. Hedda always had a smile and was so quick to respond just as her team does. I will definitely be referring friends to the company and all military personnel I come across. She is the greatest!

I genuinely cannot say enough about Hedda. Kind, courteous, professional, caring, and honest don't even begin to describe what a wonderful individual she is. I first found Hedda through Zillow. Upon our very first phone conversation, it was instantaneously apparent that Hedda was different from the other agents I had interviewed. I was searching for my very first home, and wanted the best professional on my side. I got very lucky to have found Hedda, as she is truly the best. Hedda painstakingly searched countless properties for me. She was incredibly flexible and accommodating with her time. She worked with me in every way possible to ensure that I found a home I love, got a great deal, and was happy with my purchase. Hedda was there next to me every step of the way. She took the time to explain the smallest of details, and was always available to me when I needed her. When we finally closed the deal, she met my wife and I at our new home to give us the keys. Being the kind, sweet, and caring individual that she is, she even brought us a gift to help celebrate the occasion. I now consider Hedda a dear friend, and have and will continue to recommend her to anyone looking for the very best real estate professional in San Diego. If you are seeking an agent who will be in your corner, will be completely honest and transparent, and will have your best intentions at heart, there really is no substitute for Hedda Parashos.

I've purchased and sold several properties in Northern California and San Diego. Like all real estate owners, I always want to sell high and buy low. Hedda helped me accomplish that. She helped me sell quickly while maximizing my profit and helped me purchase a home at fair market vale while also helping me negotiate through requests for repairs. Hedda's team kept me informed throughout the escrow process making sure contractual timeframes were met in a timely manner. I look forward to having Hedda and her team represent me in future transactions. You could expect to be in good hands if you have to opportunity to work with Hedda and her team.

Hedda and her team really know how to take care of you. She was always available when we needed her and answered all of our many questions. She made the process really easy, you can tell that she has the experience, is good at what she does, and cares about her clients. It was truly a great experience working with her and we highly recommend her to anyone looking for a home.
Hedda understood how and who to market our home too. She was personable, professional and responsive. She got us the top of the market price and negotiated in a highly skilled way.

As a first time buyer, Hedda did an amazing job for us. She is so kind and caring, she responded to all our questions with patience and kindness. We worked with some agents before but non of them were responsive like Hedda. She made our purchase so easy and she was with us in every step from the beginning. Defiantly we work with her again.

Hedda is amazing! Everything she does comes from her heart first. She's very kind and listens closely to your wants and needs. She has an open mindset. I've worked with some agents before but none of them were as responsive as Hedda is. She makes buying and selling simple, due to her incredible patience. She will definitely with you every step of the way. Two thumbs up!

Jodi is awesome. Super knowledgeable, super friendly, always on time, seemingly always on the job. She worked with us around our hectic schedule over several months as we navigated areas all over San Diego, and finally settled on a property in Ramona. Led us through all the paperwork, before during and after we signed, and even much after we signed as we needed stuff. We've had a few realtors in the past - Jodi is the best.

Chris was professional and helpful throughout the process. He was very responsive and knew what had to get done. His knowledge of the market and his team helped my family. Cannot reccomend him enough.

Working with Vanda to buy our home was an incredible experience from start to finish. From day one, she took the time to truly understand what we were looking for and gave us honest, invaluable guidance about different neighborhoods and market conditions. When viewing homes, Vanda had an incredible eye for details we would have completely missed, pointing out potential red flags as well as great opportunities. During the offer and escrow process, her negotiation skills and quick communication made all the difference. She kept every step moving smoothly and fought to get us the best possible deal. We felt fully supported the entire time and couldn't be happier with our new home. If you are looking to buy, I can't recommend Vanda enough!

Incredibly Helpful all Around! Debbie was extremely helpful with helping me find the right property. She had a wealth of knowledge about the market and the areas of interest, helped me secure a great deal on the property, and was a joy to spend time with all around. She did a great job communicating with me and the other parties which helped get this deal across the line.

"Honest, Strong Negotiator, Problem-Solver, Proactive Investment Expert, 5-Star Service!” Working with Debbie Lawes to buy our investment condo was an absolute pleasure. Debbie has a phenomenal understanding of the rental market and is a powerhouse negotiator. She successfully lowered the final sale price and knew exactly which builder incentives to demand. What we appreciate most is her straightforward, honest attitude. Debbie gives you the raw pros and cons of every property, even telling us point-blank when a place was overpriced. She is incredibly punctual, flexible with scheduling, and highly proactive in sharing upcoming listings before they hit the market. Her service didn't stop at the contract; when we hit a major coverage gap with the builder's home insurance, she immediately connected us with an insurance agent who provided superior coverage at a competitive rate. Debbie seamlessly handles hurdles and truly protects your bottom line. We highly recommend Debbie Lawes!

Sergio made our home-buying process so smooth. We gave him a list of our needs, wishes and budget. After just one day of viewing homes, we found one that checked every box on the list and he was able to negotiate the best possible offer for both the seller and buyer. He is very knowledgeable, attentive & was responsive at all times of the day that worked with our schedule in order to help us close in less than a month! We highly recommend him to anyone looking to buy a home.

Robby is the best realtor in San Diego to work with because of his knowledge of the area, his dedicated hard work to find the best properties, and his unbiased opinions - he really works for his customers with their best interests in mind. This is my second time working with Robby and I have found my perfect place at the perfect price for me both times. I highly recommend working with Roby Gmur!!

We feel so lucky to have had Deborah as our real estate agent. From our very first conversation, she made us feel comfortable, listened carefully to what we were looking for, and guided us through every step of the process with patience and genuine care. She was always available to answer our questions, explain every detail, and offer honest advice that helped us make confident decisions. In just 5 weeks since our first conversation, sale closed and we are very happy homeowners. Thanks Deborah!

Debbie was the utmost professional and knew exactly what needed to be done when and the best professionals for the jobs. She communicated perfectly and was concise yet thorough at appropriate times. I can't imagine there being a more well suited agent for any transaction, either side, she was right on the ball throughout.

Debbie responded quickly and got my house up for sale within days of contact. She prepared the sale, took photos and proposed sale price quickly, showed the house and found a buyer within days. She was also very helpful facilitating the sale for me at a distance and she coordinated everything in my place. Would definately use her again.
